assign.outcome: **Nine of the twelve dashboard requests hold up exactly as the earlier audit graded them; three needed a correction, all backed by code and a headless screenshot, not the audit's word.** idea-cards was graded done and is only partly there (its wall is a variable-width responsive grid with a card-width slider, not two equal columns). realtime-v3's console-error monitor is described as relaying errors right now; its own task log shows it was shut off the moment it landed, and no such process is running on this machine at this moment (a sibling minion verifying the server topic found the same dead process independently). v3-layout and v3-card-look both blame 'two EQUAL columns' as something still missing from V3 - the CSS and a live screenshot both show the columns genuinely are 50/50 at load with a working drag handle; what is actually still missing is full-bleed and the hour-lined timeline. The other nine rows (ai-v2, version-picker, ai-v3, spatial-timeline, current-view, v3-prompts, v3-cards-css, joint-timeline) were re-checked independently against the code, the live site and the owner's full 53-message chat log, and land on the same verdict the audit gave, sometimes with sharper evidence - spatial-timeline and joint-timeline both trace to a task directory with a finished brief and zero lines of task log, proof no agent was ever sent. Left: the historical claim that V3 first went up literally blank with one 'ready' card could not be re-verified, since the page has moved far past that moment and this repo's framework work ships uncommitted with no git history to check. Also found, not mine to fix: public/framework/ai/usage.json currently carries a UTF-8 BOM, the exact silent-corruption trap the new-task skill warns about.
